§a[Tier 6 LuV] Ultimate Compact Mega Processing Factory§r
123T's flagship machine: the Ultimate Compact Mega Processing Factory.
Combines fifteen industrial processing modes. Switch categories with a screwdriver; use programmed circuits 20/21/22 to switch modes within a category:
  Metal: Compressor, Lathe, Electromagnetic Polariser
  Fluid: Fermenter, Fluid Extractor, Extractor
  Misc: Laser Engraver, Autoclave, Fluid Solidifier
  Isa: Isa Grinder, Industrial Flotation Cell, Vacuum Drying Furnace
  Col: Molecular Reassembler, Brewery, Fluid Heater
Parallel rule: each additional voltage tier reduces parallel operations by 2, down to a minimum of 9; base parallel: 256.
